artworks.title: The Madonna and Child in a Garden
artworks.date: 19th century facsimile after an engraving of c. 1465-1467
artworks.description: The image displays two figures, a woman seated with a child on her lap. The woman has long hair and wears a detailed garment. Both figures wear crowns. In the background are architectural elements and a round window. There are decorations like potted plants and a low landscape. The image has a textured, monochromatic appearance.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered under a large stone archway. The scene shows people with various expressions and gestures around a reclining figure in the foreground. Architectural elements and a bright sun are visible in the background. The foreground features a grand stone structure with large pillars on either side, with a ruinous archway framing the gathering. Detailed woodwork and a heavenly light source create the backdrop. The architectural motifs suggest an ancient or classical setting, with lush vegetation and a distant view of a settlement visible through the arch. The scene is rich in texture and intricate linework, adding depth and timelessness to the composition.

artworks.title: Banquet in the Park of a French Castle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a garden gathering with musicians, a feasting table, and playful interactions. The scene showcases a rustic outdoor banquet with a round table filled with dishes and various figures in period attire. The setting is lush and verdant, with foliage providing a natural canopy above the grouping. To the left, an archway framed by sculpted greenery suggests an entrance to a more formal space. In the foreground, a small dog engages playfully with a standing figure leaning on a sword. Musicians are playing instruments, and some figures are reclined on the grass, implying a sense of leisure and festivity. The drawing features fine lines and intricate details capturing the dynamic and joyful spirit of the gathering.

artworks.title: Maniere d'exposer les nobles apres leur mort
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper

artworks.title: Rendezvous in the Palais Royal
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite with stumping, pen and brown ink, and touches of white chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a classical statue on a pedestal surrounded by figures etched into the background. The image shows a detailed charcoal or pencil drawing of a nude male statue on a stone pedestal. The statue's pose is classic, with one hand holding a cloth and the other resting on its shoulder. The setting includes intricate background details such as another figure-like sculpture in the shadows. Towards the right, there are sketches of seated figures, possibly women, suggested by their attire and demeanor. The style and composition suggest an academic study of form and posture, rendered with meticulous attention to detail found in classic art. The shading techniques emphasize the contours of the body and create a sense of light and shadow. The drawing is dated "20 May 1774" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to Mary Magdalene
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 16 x 15.8 cm (6 5/16 x 6 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures engaged in interaction. One figure is kneeling, partially turned towards the figure standing on the right. The kneeling figure has long curly hair covered by a veil or hood, and is dressed in a gown with medieval-style folds. She reaches out with one hand towards an object resembling a container. The standing figure has long, wavy hair and a beard, and is draped in a cloak. He holds a staff with a cross in one hand and gestures with the other. The background features rolling hills, scattered trees, and a wattle fence.

artworks.title: Page from a Book of Hours
artworks.medium: manuscript page with text and illuminated initials on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Dimitri T. Tselos
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page. The image depicts a page from a medieval illuminated manuscript calendar, featuring rows of text organized by date. The titles are marked in black and red ink, with significant dates highlighted. There is an elaborately decorated blue and gold initial at the top left corner of the page. The manuscript is written in Latin, featuring the names of religious figures or saints associated with each day. The combination of ornate lettering and meticulous script reflects the artistic and textual craftsmanship common to medieval manuscript traditions.

artworks.title: The Beautiful Virgin of Regensburg
artworks.medium: woodcut printed from six blocks in red, green, blue, light orange, brown, and black
artworks.description: This print shows a woman standing and holding a child by her hip. Her body is slightly turned to the left, but her head is turned towards us. She has pale skin and brown hair covered by a blue hooded shawl that she wears, which features long fringe at the sleeves. Below the shawl she appears to wear a green-and-red garment with long sleeves. The child also has pale skin and curly brown hair. They are wearing a red tunic and holding a small scroll in their left hand. The woman has a large red halo around her head, filled with thin green lines that radiate from her. The child also has a halo of red lines radiating from their head. Surrounding the pair is an ornate architectural frame with colorful decorative elements and an inscription at the bottom. The background is off-white.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.8 x 18.7 cm (10 9/16 x 7 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene. The drawing features a central figure kneeling in prayer next to a resting baby atop a bed of hay, flanked by angels in adoration. Surrounding the central figures are animals and a figure holding a candle, with architecture depicting arches and columns in the background. The scene also includes shepherds and additional figures observing from a distance. The detailed line work and shading bring a sense of texture and depth to the piece.

artworks.title: Nude Model Seated
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person seated with their legs crossed and arms resting on their knees. The figure is depicted in a frontal position, leaning slightly forward with their head resting on their hands. Their facial features are detailed, showing a contemplative expression, and they have curly hair that frames their face. The person appears to be unclothed, with subtle shading on the skin. The background consists of simple, sketchy lines providing a textured effect, suggesting a soft surface the person is sitting on. There is no jewelry or objects visible, and the focus is primarily on the figure itself. The overall setting is minimalistic with an emphasis on the human form and the lines that define it.

artworks.title: Old Man
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the back, depicting his upper body down to the thighs. The man is seated and turned towards the right side of the image, with his left arm partly visible. His head is slightly tilted down, and his facial features are delicate with a visible profile, showing a prominent nose and chin. His hair is short and neatly drawn with fine lines. The man is depicted without clothing. There are no discernible jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of cross-hatching lines. The overall shading and contouring are achieved through fine line work, highlighting the musculature and form of the body.

artworks.title: Study of Cupid (Head of a Girl)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a young child's face. The child has short, curly hair, wide eyes, and a slightly pursed mouth. The drawing is done in pencil with soft and delicate features. The background is a subtle, indistinct backdrop, and the image includes the artist's signature and date in the upper right corner: "A. Legros 1904."

artworks.title: E.D. Adams, 3rd plate
artworks.description: The image depicts a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing the viewer. The man has prominent eyebrows, a thick moustache, and styled hair. He is dressed in a shirt with a collar and a suit or jacket, with a textured background. The lower right corner of the image is inscribed with the signature "A. Legros."

artworks.title: Beggar with Hat in Hand (Mendiant avec son chapeau a la main)
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing an elderly man seated against the trunk of a tree with several branches extending around him. The focus is on the upper portion of his body, with his head bowed and his hands resting in his lap, holding a hat. He has a full head of hair and a beard covering his face, which is etched with lines that capture the contours of his expression and features. He is clothed in a draped garment, which appears loose and flowing, covering most of his body. The background is simple, with the prominent tree trunk behind him and minimal details, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Corner of a Wood (Coin d'un bois)
artworks.description: The image shows a view from ground level within a grove of trees. The horizon is in the distance towards the right side of the image, showing rolling hills and faint outlines of mountain peaks extending across the landscape. The etching is detailed with fine linework and cross-hatching techniques, creating texture and depth in the trees and foliage. Tall trees with thick trunks and intricate branches and leaves are in the foreground, while the background displays open fields and patches of trees. The artwork is in a monochrome palette, highlighting contrast and shadows. The sky is lightly sketched, blending with the distant mountains.

artworks.title: Night Crier (Le crieur de nuit)
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the side with his head tilted upwards. The man has a furrowed brow, long beard, and unkempt hair. He has deep-set eyes and an intense expression. He is wearing a garment with a loose collar and appears to be holding it close to his chest with one hand, while the other hand rests below. The background is a textured surface with no discernible objects.

artworks.title: Hamlet near the Lake (Le hameau pres du lac)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching with a countryside scene. The sky occupies the upper half of the composition, with the horizon high in the frame. In the distance, a structure is partially hidden by trees. The etched lines provide detailed textures to the foliage and terrain. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and brown. A figure is bending towards the ground in the foreground.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man (Etude de tete)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an older man with a bowed head. He has deeply lined facial features, prominent eyebrows, a long, full beard, and sparse hair on top that flows into the beard. The man is not wearing visible clothing or accessories. The background has vertical lines for depth, and the sketch has hatching and cross-hatching to suggest shadow and form.

artworks.title: Fishermen's Wives (Femmes de pecheurs)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of four women. Three women are seated and one is standing. The standing woman is gazing into the distance, her body visible from head to toe. She wears a headscarf and traditional clothing. The seated women also wear headscarves and dresses, and one has her face covered with her hands. They are near a stone structure or wall with a wooden post nearby. In the background, there are loose lines indicating a landscape. The scene conveys a quiet, contemplative moment outdoors.

artworks.title: Solitude (Solitude (Paysage))
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and hills. The view is from a slight elevation, possibly a hilltop. Trees line the land, with a distant hill in the background also covered in trees. The drawing style is detailed, showing the trees and land contours. In the foreground, there are tall trees with a figure leaning against one, wearing a hat. The middle ground has rolling hills, while the background shows sparser scenery. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of pencil or ink.

artworks.title: Meadow in Sunshine (Le pre ensoleille)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the composition, with rolling hills visible beyond a cluster of trees. The etching technique includes intricate and fluid brushstrokes, providing texture and depth to the foliage and ground. The monochrome palette features shades of black and gray, enhancing the details of the trees and landscape. A figure is reclining on the ground, looking towards the trees.

artworks.title: Monk Playing the Organ in Church (Moine jouant de l'orgue a l'eglise)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group of individuals gathered around an organist. The scene depicts a single figure seated at an organ, playing the instrument with open sheet music in front of them. Surrounding the organist is a small assembly of observers, sitting or standing at different levels, wrapped in dark cloaks or robes. The artwork emphasizes shadow and light, with intricate details in the clothing and architecture. In the background, an arched doorway can be seen.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.description: The image shows a view from within a wooded area. Slender tree trunks and tangled branches stretch vertically across the frame, fading gently into the lighter tones on the left side. The horizon is not distinctly defined but is suggested by the fading light and shadow transitioning upwards and to the left. The brushstrokes or sketch lines are soft, fluid, and somewhat diagonal. The overall color palette is a subdued monochromatic sepia tone, creating a calm, ethereal atmosphere as the intricacies of the trees blend into the misty environment beyond them.

artworks.title: Little Burner of Grass (Le petit bruleur d'herbe)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of a rustic country scene. A figure is working in the foreground, with sparse vegetation. In the background, there is a stone structure with conical roofs surrounded by lush trees. The illustration features precise line work, shading, and a monochromatic sepia color palette.
